ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the circuit diagram, the power supply U_CC on the right connects the upper and lower two power rails, with the upper end marked as positive and the lower end marked as negative, therefore the lower power rail can be used as the 0 V reference point. The Zener diode VS on the left is marked U_Z, with the positive sign on top and the negative sign on bottom; it is connected between the transistor base node and the lower power rail. The emitter of transistor VT is connected to the lower power rail through R_E, and the collector is connected to the upper power rail through R_C. Reasoning: The Zener diode stabilizes the base voltage as V_B = U_Z = 5.7 V. This transistor is an NPN transistor; the emitter voltage is lower than the base by one forward base-emitter junction voltage drop U_BE = 0.7 V, so V_E = V_B - U_BE = 5.7 - 0.7 = 5.0 V.

method.method_draft: From the image, form the bias loop from the zener-stabilized base node through the base-emitter junction and R_E to the lower rail. Write U_Z = U_BE + I_E R_E, so I_E = (5.7 - 0.7)/2.5 kΩ = 2 mA. Since the bottom of R_E is on the reference rail, V_E is the voltage across R_E: V_E = I_E R_E = 2 mA × 2.5 kΩ = 5 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路图右侧是直流电源 U_CC，上端为正、下端为负；上、下两条导线构成电源轨。晶体管 VT 的集电极通过 R_C 接到上电源轨，发射极通过 R_E 接到下电源轨。左侧 R_1 从上电源轨接到基极偏置节点，该节点同时接稳压管 VS，稳压管两端标注 U_Z，且上端为正、下端接下电源轨为负。因此，基极节点相对于下电源轨由稳压管稳定为 U_Z。推理：按照图中的偏置回路，从稳压后的基极节点经过晶体管的基极-发射极结，再经过 R_E 到下参考轨，有 U_Z = U_BE + I_E R_E。代入 U_Z = 5.7 V，U_BE = 0.7 V，R_E = 2.5 kΩ，得到 I_E = (5.7 - 0.7) / 2.5 kΩ = 5.0 V / 2.5 kΩ = 2 mA。因为 R_E 下端接参考下轨，所以发射极电压 V_E 就是 R_E 上的电压：V_E = I_E R_E = 2 mA × 2.5 kΩ = 5 V。最终答案：5 V。
